title: request
description: Client to resident: run the words of a command line, exactly as typed after : in Flash. The resident answers a result, or an error with the same id.

id.description: Chosen by the client, 1 to 128 bytes; the reply carries it back. Distinct among the connection's requests in flight.

cwd.description: Where relative paths in the words resolve (open, :!, menu choose --file). Absolute.
